_doc: Single source for per-agent model tier, startup skill loads and context caps. Startup tokens = always_loaded files + the agent definition + SKILL.md of every skill in `load` (estimate: chars/4). `on_demand` skills are loaded only when a task step needs them. scripts/context-budget.mjs enforces caps; scripts/validate-agents.mjs enforces model and tool consistency. Change a tier or cap here with a plan/DECISIONS.md entry.

design-director.reason: Owns the premium/taste bar: three divergent directions, critic synthesis and visual review. Wrong taste here is the most expensive rework.

frontend.reason: Implements immersive motion, scroll and interaction against DESIGN.md/MOTION.md; hardest code and costly to redo.

taste-research.reason: Extracts mechanisms from video frames and live references; needs strong vision and judgment about originality and rights.

research.reason: Structured reference and competitor gathering with sources.

ux.reason: Flows, IA and wireframes built from Brain patterns.

product-manager.reason: Scope and acceptance judgment; no gate authority.

backend.reason: Contact action, email, CMS and env, following a fixed recipe.

growth.reason: SEO/AEO/GEO data files and audit against fixed rules.

ship.reason: Runs deterministic G3 commands; reasons only when one fails.

production-auditor.reason: Phased audit with evidence; repairs are low-risk and verified.

brain-evaluator.reason: Offline diagnosis and candidate evaluation over JSON records.

link-building.reason: Source-backed plan; weaker models risk inventing sources. Revisit after measured traces.

domain-ops.reason: Read-only DNS/TLS verification that records command output; no authority to change records.
